alt: STEP 1 OF 5: Apply to join — Message us on WhatsApp or fill in the Google Form. Takes about two minutes.
STEP 2 OF 5: Get your code — We send you a referral code that identifies every customer you bring.
STEP 3 OF 5: Share your link — Send your link to anyone who needs a website. Post it anywhere.
STEP 4 OF 5: We build it — Requirements, design, development, deployment and support. All handled.
STEP 5 OF 5: You get paid — Your commission is paid once the customer completes payment.
